entities.summary: Angelina Vadimovna Lazareva (Lazarenko) (Russian: Ангели́на Вади́мовна Лазарева (Лазаре́нко), IPA: [ɐnɡʲɪˈlʲinə vɐˈdʲiməvnə ləzɐˈrʲenkə]; born 13 April 1998) is a Russian volleyball player, a member of the Russia women's national volleyball team. Since the 2019/2020 season, she has played for Dinamo Krasnodar.
